verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official SDK packages. GoDaddy does publish machine-readable OpenAPI contracts for Domains v1/v2/v3 and Commerce APIs, plus an end-to-end workflow with curl, Node, Python and Go examples, so developers can build against official specs and generate clients rather than use first-party SDKs. missing for 10: evidence of official language SDK libraries (e.g., npm/PyPI/Go packages), SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
